ModalWrapper.reason: ModalWrapper is deprecated in Carbon React v11 (removed in v12) in favor of ComposedModal + a custom trigger button (see migration.mdx). Ember's existing Modal component (src/components/modal.gts) is already a block-based header/body/footer component matching the recommended ComposedModal-style pattern, with the trigger button left to the consumer as React's own migration guide recommends. No standalone Ember equivalent needed.
